original_test_intent: Verify each approved NVMe bay's Access/Busy LED transitions according to the platform specification during controlled activity and returns to idle without storage errors.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts and observes each mapped SSD while the agent runs an approved read-only or isolated-file workload on that exact target and captures synchronized I/O, health and full log evidence.
manual_activity: User approves all drive/slot LED and workload mappings; qualified operator inserts and observes each drive; agent runs only approved target-specific I/O.
required_inputs: Access/Busy state, color, cadence and timing specification
Per-drive safe activity workload, rate/duration and data boundary
Supported insertion/hot-swap, RAID/mount/boot and backup plan
Qualified operator, secure controller/BMC access, OOB and abort limits
safety_requirements: Bind every workload to stable identity and exclude boot/production/unknown/raw targets
Verify insertion support and storage state per bay
Preserve logs and record start/stop timestamps
Stop on wrong target, unexpected write, RAID/filesystem/I/O/thermal/power/BMC error or anomalous LED
Never use raw IPMI or Locate as activity proof
agent_execution_scope: Capture per-drive idle mapping, counters and health
Launch/stop the approved workload and record target-specific telemetry
Collect complete controller/OS/BMC evidence and verify return to idle
Do not handle hardware, observe LEDs remotely, rebuild/recover or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide operator and judge physical evidence
Review each drive independently and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Locate/raw IPMI is non-equivalent to Access/Busy, may target the wrong component and includes insecure credentials; lsblk alone lacks activity proof.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run a bounded approved workload on each stable target with per-device counters and complete health/log capture while the operator records idle, active and post-stop LED phases.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All approved NVMe insertions, Access/Busy LED checks and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute an identity-locked idle/activity/recovery matrix for every drive with synchronized physical and telemetry evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unsafe non-equivalent controls with real activity and complete traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation generates/records activity but cannot replace physical observations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Background array work and cache may distort one bay's signal; quiet intervals and counters are required per drive.

project_override_considerations: If an LED aggregates several bays or drive types, the approved vendor mapping must define acceptable scope; per-drive exclusivity cannot be assumed.
expected_evidence: Operator identity and timestamped idle/active/post-I/O photos/video per drive
Exact workload targets/commands/PIDs/results and I/O counters

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently target NVMe Access/Busy behavior despite broad HDD grouping; DeepSeek's method is incomplete, not source ambiguity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping, workloads and operator are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Creates independent per-drive activity evidence and rejects raw/Locate shortcuts for the physical Access/Busy path.
independent_technical_reasoning: Access indication must correlate with actual traffic on the same physical device. Controller caches and background work can produce misleading activity, so each drive requires a known quiet baseline, target-specific counters, controlled workload and observed return to idle; raw LED control bypasses all of this behavior.
